title: MeterReading
description: One multimeter reading typed or spoken by the user, or read by the app from a Bluetooth meter, in response to a NextAction. The only kind of evidence that counts as proof (I1, I2). Sent into fusion. `kind` fixes the shape of `value`: voltage_dc -> {volts}; continuity -> {continuity} and pins required; resistance -> {ohms} and pins required. RepairOS's verdict (`verdict`) is judged against [min, max] in code.

net.description: Net name from the design's electrical reference. Not a harness wire name.

pins.description: REF.PIN ids probed, in the design's net naming (e.g. J1.1), not harness end names. Required for continuity and resistance; optional for voltage_dc ([probe +, probe -]).

value.description: Exactly the field that matches kind (see allOf).

condition.description: Operating condition when read. We use it to pick which part of the SPICE [min, max] applies.

expected.description: What RepairOS judged against. volts_min/volts_max come from the reference's expected {min, max}, never from a single expected value.

verdict.description: RepairOS's verdict, computed in code against expected (inside [min - tol, max + tol], tol = 0.25 V or 5 %; under 5 ohm conducts).

source.description: `ble`: the app read the value from the meter over Bluetooth LE; nobody typed or said it. Then `meter` says which meter and how it was set.

meter.description: The meter that produced a `ble` reading, as the app read it over Bluetooth. Absent for typed and voice readings.

mode.description: The mode the meter was in when the value was read.

range.description: The meter's own range label, or "auto".

interval_ms.description: Update interval the app asked the meter for, in milliseconds.

battery_v.description: The meter's battery voltage when read.

read_at.description: When the app received the value from the meter.

raw_text.description: What the user said or typed, before parsing.

continuity.description: True when the meter beeps / reads under 5 ohm.
